column4: MySQL-ONLY by subject, so it skips as ONE test rather than per dialect: the defect is MySQL's JSON column type narrowing a number, and PostgreSQL's JSONB and SQL Server's NVARCHAR(MAX) never had it. The gate is testutil.TestDB(t, DialectMySQL) at the top of the function, so the whole test skips and its 81 subtests never register -- one skip, not eighty-one, and not two. Measured by NAME with only CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES set (skipped: the bare test name; passed: nothing), not derived from a delta and not counted with all three DSNs set, where it would read zero. Guards cleat#1622: nine plugin JSON columns rewrote any integer outside [-2^63, 2^64-1] and any decimal past float64 precision, with no error and no log. Compares BYTES, never decoded numbers -- a float64 decode recovers 2^64 exactly and is blind precisely at the boundary.
